title: Record discussion: the header shows a comment count of 0 above "You don't have permission to view comments"
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed split. Triage on #27520 (6495077487) said: 「Each row is either taken, with its own card where it needs code」. This card is row 2.
Business reason: a member who may not read a record's comments sees `Discussion (0)` right above the refusal. The count states something the member cannot know and the server did not say: that there are no comments. They may conclude nobody has discussed the record, when the discussion is only hidden from them.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`, the record page's discussion panel).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "Discussion count shown when comments cannot be read permission" → #27703 (mention picker, row 1 of the same parent; a different defect), #24864 and #19607 (closed, unrelated). **New.**

## What happens (row 2 of #27520, 18.3.0 RC walkthrough at `c4c515ad`)

Member, desktop, Projects → Website Relaunch, a record whose comments the member may not read. The header reads `Discussion (0)` directly above "You don't have permission to view comments on this record."

## Mechanism (read on `origin/main`, not reproduced here)

- The refusal line is `detail.commentsAccessDenied` in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` ~L356.
- The `Discussion` title is drawn in `RecordChatterPanel.tsx` (~L165, ~L232) and `DetailView.tsx` (~L2025). The count that sits beside it is computed from the loaded comment list, which is empty when the read is refused. Measure which one draws `(0)` on the record page.

## Expected

When the comments cannot be read, the header shows no count: just `Discussion`, or the same header the panel draws with no count. When the comments can be read, the count is unchanged, including `(0)` for a readable record that has none.

## Acceptance

- One measured repro on current `main` first, naming the component that draws the count.
- A test with a refused comment read: the header shows no count and the refusal line still shows.
- Controls: a readable record with 0 comments shows `(0)`; one with 3 shows `(3)`.
- An ablation that goes red.

Links back: #27520 (row 2)
